note: The approved new item list (2026-11-10 review), the four cut entries left out and the review's changes made. Item and potion names and descriptions are used word for word; sets are formed, never dropped.

items.name: Tea Urn
items.desc: Every Thermos you carry makes all your hits 5% harder.

items.name: Flask Holster
items.desc: Carry 4 more Thermoses, and get 2 now.

items.name: Bottomless Flask
items.desc: Every 2nd fight room you clear gives a Thermos back.

items.name: Hot Soup Thermos
items.desc: Thermos blasts leave a puddle of burning soup for 3 seconds.

items.name: Pressure Cooker
items.desc: Thermos blasts are 50% bigger, but the fuse is 0.3 seconds longer.

items.name: Tea Cosy
items.desc: Your own Thermos blasts never hurt you.

items.name: Second Brew
items.desc: When a Thermos explodes, a few little bombs fly out and go off a second time.

items.name: Overarm Bowler
items.desc: Thermoses are thrown, not placed, and burst where they land.

items.name: Tea Break
items.desc: A blast that hits 3 or more enemies heals half a pill.

items.name: Filing Cabinet
items.desc: Every Slip you carry makes all your hits 5% harder.

items.name: In Triplicate
items.desc: Every Slip you pick up counts as 2.

items.name: Duplicate Key Cutter
items.desc: Get 3 Slips now, and start every floor with 1 more.

items.name: Loose Paperwork
items.desc: Each Slip you carry, up to 5, is a sheet of paper circling you that blocks one shot, then grows back after a room.

items.name: Rubber Stamp Collection
items.desc: Every Slip you spend pays 15 Pension.

items.name: Paper Cuts
items.desc: Your combo finisher flings a paper slip that cuts through every enemy in a line. It costs nothing.

items.name: Locksmith's Apron
items.desc: Urns, chests and locked doors cost one Slip fewer, never less than one.

items.name: Desk Drawer
items.desc: Picking up a Slip also gives a Thermos, and picking up a Thermos also gives a Slip, once per room each.

items.name: Money Belt
items.desc: Every 50 Pension you carry makes all your hits 5% harder, up to 50%.

items.name: Piggy Bank
items.desc: A hit that would cost a pill costs 20 Pension instead, while you have it.

items.name: Compound Interest
items.desc: At the start of every floor, the Pension you carry grows by 15%.

items.name: Senior Discount Card
items.desc: Everything in shops is 25% cheaper.

items.name: Haggler's Hat
items.desc: One item in every shop is free.

items.name: Coupon Booklet
items.desc: Shops sell one more item.

items.name: Gold Fillings
items.desc: Each bite has a 25% chance to knock a coin loose.

items.name: Coin Purse Cane
items.desc: Every 10 Pension you pick up loads a coin, and your next swing fires it as a shot.

items.name: Inheritance Letter
items.desc: Pays 75 Pension the moment you open it.

items.name: Rex, the Late Dog
items.desc: Your old dog trots beside you and bites the nearest enemy every second.

items.name: Mittens
items.desc: The late cat pounces on any enemy below a quarter of its health and finishes it.

items.name: Joey the Budgie
items.desc: A budgie circles you and blocks a shot every 3 seconds.

items.name: Shelley the Tortoise
items.desc: A tortoise plods after you. Shots that hit her stop, and she can't be hurt.

items.name: Racing Pigeon
items.desc: A pigeon fetches Pension, Slips and Thermoses from anywhere in the room.

items.name: Pocketful of Moths
items.desc: Two moths circle you, nibble enemies they touch and block shots.

items.name: Trouser Ferret
items.desc: Every dodge, a ferret leaps out and bites the nearest enemy hard.

items.name: Old Shep
items.desc: A sheepdog herds enemies into a bunch in front of you every few seconds.

items.name: Polly the Parrot
items.desc: A parrot on your shoulder copies your last attack a second later.

items.name: Pet Rock
items.desc: Counts as a pet. Pet items make it bigger, and once big enough it blocks shots.

items.name: Tin of Dog Treats
items.desc: Your pets hit 50% harder and move faster.

items.name: Pet Cemetery Plot
items.desc: Every pet you have makes all your hits 8% harder.

items.name: Extra Strong Dentures
items.desc: Thrown dentures bite 50% harder and through 2 enemies.

items.name: Boomerang Bite
items.desc: The dentures fly back by themselves, biting on the way.

items.name: Spare Set
items.desc: Throw two sets of dentures at once, in a spread.

items.name: Shark Tooth Implant
items.desc: Bites make enemies bleed, and bleeds stack.

items.name: Denture Glue Gun
items.desc: The dentures stick to the first enemy they bite and keep biting for 2 seconds.

items.name: Chattering Ricochet
items.desc: After each bite, the dentures jump to the next nearest enemy, up to 3 times.

items.name: Chattering Wind-Up Teeth
items.desc: Dentures lying on the floor bite anything that walks over them.

items.name: Fizzy Cleaning Tablet
items.desc: Bites fizz and slow enemies by half for 2 seconds.

items.name: Dentures in a Glass
items.desc: While your dentures are out, your swings are 25% faster.

items.name: Cane Sword
items.desc: A fully charged swing also sends a shockwave forward.

items.name: Brass Cane Topper
items.desc: Combo finishers hit in a ring all around you.

items.name: Lightning Rod Cane
items.desc: A fully charged swing calls a bolt down on every enemy it hits.

items.name: Grandma's Rolling Pin
items.desc: Every swing becomes a slow, huge overhead smash that also hits behind you.

items.name: The Reaper's Other Scythe
items.desc: Fully charged swings become a wide spinning sweep all around you.

items.name: Knitting Needles
items.desc: Every swing also pokes two needles forward.

items.name: Shepherd's Crook Handle
items.desc: Your combo finisher hooks the enemies it hits and pulls them to you.

items.name: Rusty Hinge
items.desc: The third swing of a combo stuns for a full second.

items.name: Bingo Dabber
items.desc: Hits dab a mark on an enemy, and the fifth mark bursts for a big hit.

items.name: Obituary Clippings
items.desc: Each kill in a room makes your hits there 5% harder, up to 50%. A counter shows it.

items.name: Funeral Director's Pocket Watch
items.desc: A narrow dodge slows time to a crawl for a second.

items.name: Wheelchair Wheels
items.desc: Dodges become a longer roll that runs over enemies on the way.

items.name: Titanium Hip
items.desc: Dodge through an enemy and it takes a full swing's damage.

items.name: Pogo Cane
items.desc: A close-call dodge makes the dodge ready again at once.

items.name: Velcro Shoes
items.desc: Dodge twice in a row.

items.name: Afterimage
items.desc: A pale copy of you stays where a dodge began, and enemies go for it for a second.

items.name: Bad Hip
items.desc: Every dodge leaves a big cough cloud that slows enemies by half for 3 seconds.

items.name: Rocking Chair Rhythm
items.desc: Right after a dodge, the next swing hits twice as hard.

items.name: Heart Monitor
items.desc: Every pill of maximum health makes your hits 6% harder.

items.name: Hospital Bracelet
items.desc: One more pill.

items.name: Comfort Care Lanyard
items.desc: One more pill, and every heal gives one more.

items.name: Spare Pill Organizer
items.desc: Heals taken at full health are stored, up to 3, and each soaks one hit.

items.name: Casserole Dish
items.desc: The first kill in every room heals half a pill.

items.name: Life Alert Button
items.desc: The first hit in every room is blocked.

items.name: Life Jacket
items.desc: Once per floor, a hit that would finish you leaves one pill.

items.name: Eternal Warranty
items.desc: Once per run, death puts you back at the room's door with every pill.

items.name: Photo of the Grandkids
items.desc: On your last pill, all your damage is doubled.

items.name: Nitroglycerin Tablets
items.desc: 40% more damage, but any hit of two pills or more sets them off around you.

items.name: Polyester Suit
items.desc: Cane hits 35% harder, but a swing sometimes shocks you still for half a second, with a crackle.

items.name: Prune Juice
items.desc: Your dodge recovers twice as fast, but every dodge costs 1 Pension.

items.name: Unpaid Bill
items.desc: 50% more damage, but every fight room you enter takes 10 Pension, and with none it takes half a pill.

items.name: Glass Hip
items.desc: Walk and swing 30% faster, but every hit costs one more half pill.

items.name: Model Citizen's Badge
items.desc: Every rule you keep this run makes your hits 6% harder.

items.name: Repeat Offender
items.desc: Every rule you break this run makes your hits 6% harder. The Auditor hits harder too.

items.name: Fine Print
items.desc: The first rule you break on each floor is let off with a warning: no Auditor.

items.name: Brown Envelope
items.desc: The Auditor drops twice the Pension and always an item.

items.name: Clipboard of Your Own
items.desc: When you break a rule, the Auditor arrives on your side and fights for you that room.

items.name: Gold Star Sticker
items.desc: Keeping a rule also drops a full pill.

items.name: Photo Album
items.desc: Hold two reels instead of one.

items.name: Old Projector
items.desc: A flashback lasts one more room.

items.name: Those Were the Days
items.desc: Ending a flashback heals one pill.

items.name: Rose-Tinted Glasses
items.desc: In a flashback, all your damage is 30% higher.

items.name: Scrapbook
items.desc: Every flashback you play this run makes old Harold's hits 8% harder.

items.name: Floor Plan
items.desc: The map shows every room of a floor when you arrive.

items.name: Magnifying Glass
items.desc: Secret walls glint at you from across the room.

items.name: Alarm Clock
items.desc: Walking into a fight room stuns every enemy there for a second.

items.name: Early Bird Special
items.desc: For the first 10 seconds in a fight room you walk and swing 25% faster.

items.name: Bureaucrat's Stamp
items.desc: Every 30 seconds your next hit files a regular enemy away for good. On a boss it takes 10% of its health.

items.name: Suspicious Bifocals
items.desc: Your hits finish off any regular enemy below 15% health.

items.name: Last Orders
items.desc: The last enemy left in a room takes double damage.

items.name: Complaint Form
items.desc: Your hits on a boss fill a form, and a full form stuns it for 2 seconds.

items.name: Cactus Brooch
items.desc: Enemies that touch you take a hit and are pushed away.

items.name: Hearing Aid
items.desc: Use: a feedback screech stuns every enemy in the room for 2 seconds. Recharges over 3 rooms.

items.name: Harmonica
items.desc: Use: play the one song he knows and heal a pill. Recharges over 4 rooms.

items.name: Lottery Scratcher
items.desc: Use: scratch for a random pickup: Pension, a Slip, a Thermos, a heal or, rarely, an item. Once per floor.

items.name: Walking Frame
items.desc: Use: plant your frame. For 6 seconds it blocks every shot and enemy. Recharges over 2 rooms.

items.name: Exchange Desk
items.desc: Use: swap the number of Slips and Thermoses you carry. Recharges over 2 rooms.

items.name: Photocopier
items.desc: Use: copy a pickup lying on the floor. Recharges over 6 rooms.

items.name: Megaphone
items.desc: Use: shout a complaint that pushes every enemy in front of you back and stuns them. Recharges over 2 rooms.

items.name: Dinner Bell
items.desc: Use: your pets go wild for 5 seconds, hitting three times as hard. Recharges over 2 rooms.

items.name: Double Brew
items.desc: Drink: doubles the Thermoses you carry.

items.name: Locksmith's Tonic
items.desc: Drink: doubles the Slips you carry.

items.name: Topsy-Turvy Tonic
items.desc: Drink: swap your Slips and Thermoses.

items.name: Gold Top Milk
items.desc: Drink: every Slip and Thermos you carry pays 10 Pension, and you keep them.

items.name: Smelling Salts
items.desc: Drink: enemies in the next fight room start stunned for 3 seconds.

items.name: Dutch Courage
items.desc: Drink: 60% more damage for the next 2 rooms, but every hit you take costs double.

items.name: Tin of Pet Food
items.desc: Drink, or rather serve: your pets hit twice as hard for the rest of the floor.

items.name: Tea Lady
items.desc: With 3 Thermos items: carry 3 more Thermoses, and blasts are 25% bigger.

items.name: Civil Servant
items.desc: With 3 Slip items: every fight room cleared has a 1 in 3 chance to drop a Slip.

items.name: Penny Pincher
items.desc: With 3 Pension items: Pension flies to you from anywhere in the room, and shops are 15% cheaper.

items.name: Animal Lover
items.desc: With 3 pets: every pet hits 50% harder, and a stray cat joins for good.

items.name: Full Set
items.desc: With 3 dentures items: throw a second set every time.

items.name: Old Soldier
items.desc: With 3 cane items: every combo finisher sends a shockwave.

items.name: Spry
items.desc: With 3 dodge items: one more dodge in a row, and dodging is untouchable for longer.

items.name: Hypochondriac
items.desc: With 3 pill items: one more pill, and every heal gives half a pill more.

items.name: Daredevil
items.desc: With 3 risk items: every kill heals half a pill, once a room.

items.name: By the Book
items.desc: With 3 rules items: every floor has one more rule room, and each pays out double.

items.name: Nostalgic
items.desc: With 3 memory items: every rule room you keep drops a reel, even while you hold two.
